The paper only mentions human evaluation criteria from previous work but does not conduct its own human evaluation. overall_notes: This paper focuses on formality style transfer (FST) using a BERT-based encoder-decoder model with context-aware rule injection. The main NLG task is clearly formality style transfer. The paper uses BLEU for intrinsic evaluation and downstream classification performance for extrinsic evaluation. No human evaluation or LLM-as-judge methods are used. The extraction was generally accurate but included some metrics and criteria that were only mentioned in related work sections.
